podcast.title: Influential Rapper/Producer
podcast.body: Koopsta Knicca was also listed among the many other rappers and producers who left a significant mark on the Memphis scene, contributing powerful records. "nombres como... Cops Tanica... dejaron su vayan la escena, algunos con discos realmente potentes."

podcast.title: Part of Three 6 Mafia Mythology
podcast.body: As a member of Three 6 Mafia, Koopsta Knicca was an integral part of the band's self-created mythology. Each member, including Koopsta Knicca, was depicted as if emerging from a secret horror lodge, forming a nightmarish rock'n'roll coven from the margins of Memphis. "cada miembro, cofstanica... parecía sacado de una lujia secreta de terror."
